title: Steering the CensorShip: Uncovering Representation Vectors for LLM “Thought” Control
reasoning: The paper investigates censorship and safety-tuning mechanisms in LLMs, which are rooted in moral and ethical policy alignments. It evaluates these mechanisms using examples and benchmarks related to ethically sensitive topics, such as the permissibility of euthanasia, harassment, and political sensitivity, and includes a detailed Ethics Statement regarding the control of information and expression.
